definitions.short: Asaph , the name of three Israelites, and of the family of the first
definitions.full: H623. Asaph אָסָף proper name, masculine ( gatherer , compare Phoenician proper name, feminine אספת ) 1 father of יוֺאָח the recorder 2Kin 18:18 , 37 = Isa 36:3 , 22 . 2 one of David's chief musicians, a Levite, son of Berechiah 1Chr 6:24 (twice in verse) (|| הֵימָן v. 6:18 , אֵיתָן v. 6:29 see these names); 15:17 (|| Heman & Ethan, all called) הַמְּשֹׁרֲרִים 15:19 ; see also 16:5 (twice in verse); 16:7 compare 16:37 (|| Heman & Jeduthun 16:41 ; 16:42 ); 25:9 , named with Heman & Jeduthun also 25:6 ; 2Chr 5:12 ; 35:15 ; Psa 50:1 ; Psalm 73:1-83:18 are ascribed to Asaph; compare also וְאָסָף דָוִיד בִּימֵי Neh 12:46 ; he is called also הַחֹזֶה 2Chr 29:30 , compare עַליְֿדֵיהַמֶּלֶךְ הַנִּבָּא אָסָף 1Chr 25:2 ; repeated mention is made also of sons of Asaph בְּנֵיאָֿסָף , sons, descendants, and pupils, or those who sang and played after his manner 25:1 (|| Heman & Jeduthun) 25:2 ; 25:2 ; called הַמְּשֹׁרֲרִים 2Chr 35:15 ; Ezra 2:41 ; Neh 7:44 ; 11:22 , compare Ezra 3:10 ; performing service of purification, Hezekiah's time 2Chr 29:13 ; one of them prophesying 20:14 ; — 1Chr 26:1 for אָסָף בְּנֵי read אֶבְיָסָף בְּנֵי , compare 9:19 ; on זִכְרִי 9:15 , זַבְדִּי Neh 11:17 , זַכּוּר 12:35 , called בֶּןאָֿסָף , see these names. 3 keeper of king's park Neh 2:8 .
